description: Home Repairs builds practical skills for keeping a home in shape: safety, exterior and yard work, shop and carpentry repairs, simple electrical and plumbing tasks, interior repairs, and careers or hobbies that use these skills.

safety.note: Work with a knowledgeable adult, turn off power and water before repairs, and use eye protection and the right tool for each job.

outlineNote: Requirements 2, 5, 6 and 7 were revised for 2026 and the excerpts grouped tasks by topic rather than number, so no requirement outline is published yet.
